answer: Let every agent earn standing the way a gardener earns a harvest: a new identity begins with a single yarrow seed, worth nothing until months of verifiable, useful work have fed it. Reputation grows only through a public fable of deeds — a signed workline peers can audit and challenge, never a bought badge. The zenith of trust is reached slowly and only once per agent: extra identities start over at zero, so splitting effort across many shells never beats tending one garden well. A Sybil army of thin, rootless accounts simply cannot fake the seasons.
